```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```

**Upload Raw Data**

```{r}

bg <- as.data.frame(read_csv("../data/background-clean.csv"))
class <- as.data.frame(read_csv("../data/class-summary.csv"))
interest <- as.data.frame(read_csv("../data/interest-clean.csv"))
response_time <- as.data.frame(read_csv("../data/response-timing.csv"))
meta_data <- as.data.frame(read_csv("../data/survey-metadata.csv"))

head(bg)

```

**EDA**

```{r}

# prof (char) vs comf (double)

# programming 
prog <- bg |>
  group_by(prog.prof) |>
  summarise(
    mean = mean(prog.comf),
    median = median(prog.comf),
    count = n()) |>
  ungroup()

prog

# math 

math <- bg |>
  group_by(math.prof) |>
  summarise(
    mean = mean(math.comf),
    median = median(math.comf),
    count = n()) |>
  ungroup()

math 

# stats 

stats <- bg |>
  group_by(stat.prof) |>
  summarise(
    mean = mean(stat.comf),
    median = median(stat.comf),
    count = n()) |>
  ungroup()

stats

combined <- bg |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(prog.prof, math.prof, stat.prof,
             prog.comf, math.comf, stat.comf),
    names_to = c("subject", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(prog|math|stat)\\.(prof|comf)"
  ) |>
  group_by(subject, prof) |>
  summarise(
    mean = mean(comf, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(comf, na.rm = TRUE),
    count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

combined

```
**Visuals**
```{r}

ggplot(combined, aes(x = subject, y = mean, fill = prof)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Comfortability by Subject and Proficiency",
    x = "Subject",
    y = "Mean Comfortability",
    fill = "Proficiency"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```



*Inferences:*

-   In every subject, students who rate themselves more proficient also report higher comfort.
